result.title: Physics-Informed Graph-Based Safe RL with Constraint-Specific Critics for Community Battery Coordination in Distribution Network
result.summary: High penetrations of distributed energy resources (DERs) and fast-varying electric vehicle (EV) charging intensify voltage and line-limit violations in distribution networks (DNs), making safe, low-cost operation increasingly challenging. This paper proposes a physics-informed safe deep reinforcement learning (DRL) framework for coordinating community battery energy storage systems to mitigate constraint violations while minimizing operating cost. To represent nonlocal spatiotemporal interactions, we develop a dual-level physics-informed graph representation in which line impedance and capacity shape spatial information propagation, while power-balance, voltage-profile, and flow-reconstruction losses regularize the latent state toward control-relevant physical consistency. Building on this representation, we develop Lagrangian Dedicated-Critic PPO (LDCPPO), which implements constraint-specific value decomposition: independent reward and cost critics preserve heterogeneous voltage- and line-loading-related learning signals and combine their advantages only during the Lagrangian policy update. Case studies on DNs with high rooftop photovoltaic penetration and EV charging demonstrate that the proposed method reduces the key voltage-violation degree by up to 80.5% compared with the tested baselines, while also achieving the lowest voltage-violation count and line-overload degree with competitive operating cost.

AI.brief_summary: 提出用于社区电池协调的物理信息安全 DRL 框架：以双层物理图表示刻画非局部时空交互，用功率平衡、电压曲线与潮流重构损失正则化隐状态，并以 LDCPPO 将奖励与成本 critic 分离后再于 Lagrangian 更新中合并。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「物理一致性损失约束隐状态」与「独立 critic 分离异构信号、仅在策略更新时合成」的做法，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态的结构化监督与贡献分配线索；但领域跨度大，需较多核查。
